product_metadata.title: Moynesa Modern Moroccan Washable Area Rug, 2x4.3 Bathroom Runner Rug Entryway Rug, Non Sip Soft Front Door Rug Indoor Doormat Carpet Runner for Dining Room Office Kitchen Bedroom Laundry Room
features: [MODERN MOROCCAN RUG] - Dyed the teal of the summer sea, our Moroccan rug relaxes your space with a laid-back take on ornate motifs. Freeform loops, ivory lines and latticework pattern in white on a deeply saturated, subtle wash of teal. Moynesa offer Vintage, Antiqued, Faded, Traditional, Bohemian, Medallion, Modern, Classic, Shabby Chic and more style rug.Brings a traditional and timeless with a beautiful printed lived-in design to your home.

[SAFETY NON-SLIP RUG] - Our indoor doormat made of extra-absorbent fabric top layer and thousands of anti-skid point plastic backing which is safe for everyday indoor high traffic area from kid or pet activity.(Keep the bottom of the rug always be dry.)

[SOFT LOW-PILE THROW RUG]Our faux wool throw rug are made of enhanced synthetic durable fibers,not only ultra-soft but also resists color fading.0.39'' thick, a low-pile allows for convenient placement in entryways, underneath furniture, and will not obstruct doorways.

[FUNCTIONAL 2x4.3 RUG] - Place a small 2' X 4.3' rug by the kitchen sink for a colorful, cozy accent.Or,put a 2x3 mat for the foot of a favorite easy chair.For doormat, entryway, bathroom,a rectangle moroccan small rugs are also prerfect for daily use.

[EASY TO CARE WASHABLE RUG] - Use vacuum cleaner, broom, or wipe for daily cleaning to prevent dust and crumbs from setting into the fibers. Washer and dryer are also available for a deeper clean. It is better to wash in cold water and not to add bleach. Easily to keep a new looking.
